content.description: iZiSwap is a Discretized Liquidity AMM. As a prominent player in the DeFi Dapps space, iZiSwap specializes in delivering high-quality decentralized exchanges infrastructure. It natively supports interactions on BNB Chain and Linea, utilizing modern smart contract standards to ensure capital efficiency and robust security. The platform is dedicated to lowering the barrier to entry for both developers and retail participants. Moving forward, iZiSwap focuses on expanding its decentralized capabilities to offer unparalleled utility in the ever-growing blockchain industry.
